newsitem.title: USA: Georgia revenues rise 5.8 percent for FY 1997.
newsitem.headline: Georgia revenues rise 5.8 percent for FY 1997.

text.p: Georgia revenues rose $99.3 million or 10.2 percent in June to $1.07 billion, state Revenue Commissioner Jerry Jackson said.
Collections for fiscal 1997, which ended June 30, rose by $580.8 million or 5.8 percent over last year to $10.5 billion, Jackson said.

Revenues from individual income taxes rose 11.7 percent for the year, while corporate income tax collections rose 1.2 percent. Property tax collections rose 7 percent for the year while sales and usage tax collections rose 2.6 percent.
